Now that functions may be selected individually
that we should allow dynamically allocated trace structures to
be traced. This will allow perf to allocate a ftrace_ops structure
at runtime and use it to pick and choose which functions that
structure will trace.
Note
column2: a dynamically allocated ftrace_ops will always be called

column1: indirectly instead of being called directly from the mcount in
entry.S. This is because there's no safe way to prevent mcount
from being preempted before calling the function
modify every entry.S to do so (not likely). Thus
functions will now be called by the ftrace_ops_list_func() that
loops through the ops that are allocated if there are more than
one op allocated at a time. This loop is protected with a
preempt_disable.
To determine if an ftrace_ops structure is allocated or not
util function was added to the kernel/extable.c called
core_kernel_data()
column2: which returns 1 if the address is between

column1: _sdata and _edata.
